title: Laika has spent 20 years building up to Wildwood
summary: How the stop-motion animation studio blends traditional techniques with modern tech. According to head of animation Brad Schiff, the studio’s ethos involves mixing “old-school craft with modern technology.” With each project, he says, Laika develops new techniques.
